description: This PHP source file defines the JobCategoryAPI class, which extends endpoint functionalities to support CRUD operations for Job Category entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting job categories, along with validation rules. The class interacts with the JobCategoryService and models, and includes API documentation annotations.

classes.name: JobCategoryAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for managing Job Categories, including CRUD operations, validation, and documentation annotations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getJobCategoryService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the JobCategoryService instance used to perform business logic operations related to JobCategories.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches a specific JobCategory by its ID and returns it wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult. Throws RecordNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring the ID parameter is positive.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of JobCategories with optional sorting and pagination, returning the collection along with total count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new JobCategory based on request input, returning the created entity wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a JobCategory, ensuring the 'name' parameter is provided and valid.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing JobCategory identified by ID with new data from the request, returning the updated entity.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a JobCategory, including unique name validation excluding current record.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Helper method to assign the 'name' parameter from request to a JobCategory entity and save it.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Generates validation rule for the 'name' parameter, enforcing string type, length, and uniqueness (optional).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more JobCategories specified by IDs from the request, returning the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rule for delete operation, primarily validating presence of IDs.
